checks.name: the default keeps every fee column
checks.sql: select count(*) from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'main' and table_name not like 'stg_%' and lower(column_name) in ('platform_fee', 'net_amount', 'platform_fees', 'net_revenue', 'disputed_fee', 'total_fees')

checks.name: every reporting fee column is there
checks.sql: select count(*) from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'main' and table_name not like 'stg_%' and lower(column_name) in ('platform_fee', 'net_amount', 'platform_fees', 'net_revenue', 'disputed_fee', 'total_fees')

checks.name: platform fees match the orders
checks.sql: select (select sum(platform_fees) from main.rpt_merchant_revenue) = (select sum(platform_fee) from raw.orders)

checks.name: net revenue is gross minus the fee
checks.sql: select (select sum(net_revenue) from main.rpt_merchant_revenue) = (select sum(gross_amount - platform_fee) from raw.orders)

checks.name: ledger fees match the postings
checks.sql: select (select sum(total_fees) from main.ledger_daily) = (select sum(fee_amount) from raw.ledger_postings)

checks.name: every order is reported
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.fct_orders

checks.name: the merchant report keeps one row per merchant
checks.sql: select (select count(*) from main.rpt_merchant_revenue) = (select count(distinct merchant_id) from raw.orders)

checks.name: merchant gross revenue is unchanged
checks.sql: select (select sum(gross_revenue) from main.rpt_merchant_revenue) = (select sum(gross_amount) from raw.orders)

checks.name: the ledger keeps one row per day and account

checks.name: ledger totals are unchanged
